name: Spring Water
desc: Base: water. Calm (volatility under 1.0): Elixir. Roused (1.0 or more): Draught. Holds up to 8 potency.

name: Pressed Oil
desc: Base: oil. Calm (volatility under 1.0): Salve. Roused (1.0 or more): weapon Oil. Holds up to 6 potency.

name: Grain Spirit
desc: Base: spirit. Calm (volatility under 1.0): Fume. Roused (1.0 or more): Flask. Holds up to 5 potency. Also adds 0.5 volatility.

name: Emberbloom
desc: Essence: Ember, heat, power 3.2. Inflicts On Fire in a Flask or Oil. No effect in drinkable forms.

name: Frostmoss
desc: Essence: Rime, cold, power 2.8. Inflicts Chilled in a Flask, Fume or Oil; grants Frosted in an Elixir.

name: Nightcap
desc: Essence: Venom, poison, power 3.4. Inflicts Poisoned in a Flask, Fume or Oil. Alchemy 3.

name: Gloomcap
desc: Essence: Gloom, dark, power 2.6. Inflicts Dazzled in a Flask, Fume or Oil; grants Concealed in an Elixir. Alchemy 6.

name: Mendroot
desc: Essence: Mending, power 2.6. Restores 3.2 HP per potency in a Draught or Salve; grants Well Fed in an Elixir; cures poison and bleed in a Salve.

name: Bloodwort
desc: Essence: Vigor, power 2.4. Restores 2.6 stamina per potency in a Draught or Salve; grants Invigorated in an Elixir. Alchemy 5.

name: Thunderbloom
desc: Essence: Storm, lightning, power 3.0. Inflicts Jolted in a Flask, Fume or Oil; restores 1.6 mana per potency in a Draught or Salve; grants Clear-Headed in an Elixir. Alchemy 9.

name: Quicksilver
desc: Operator: volatility +1.3. Roused is 1.0 or more. Alchemy 2.

name: Fixing Salt
desc: Operator: sets volatility to 0.15. Each point it removes adds 50% duration (45 seconds base, cap 150). No effect on a calm brew: add Quicksilver before it.

name: Brimstone
desc: Operator: if volatility is at least 1.2 when it is added, potency ×1.55 and volatility +0.8. If not, final potency ×0.82. Alchemy 7.

name: Bone Ash
desc: Operator: removes the weakest essence added before it; the other essences' effects ×1.5 and potency ×1.25. With one essence: final potency ×1.2. With none: no effect. Alchemy 4.

name: Green Vitriol
desc: Operator: armour pierce +22%, potency ×1.25, final potency ×0.88. Alchemy 11.
